scenes.description: Visiting the Friendly Town Park and Big Zoo
Standing at the Crossroad and Finding the Bookstore
Arriving Safely at School next to the Supermarket

character_line.en: Look at the colorful town map! Where is the park?
character_line.zh: 看這張色彩繽紛的城鎮地圖！公園在哪裡呢？

options.en: The park is next to the zoo!

options.hint: 告訴 Benny 公園就在動物園旁邊「The park is next to...」喔！
仔細看地圖上的綠色公園和動物園在哪裡吧！

character_line.en: Great job! Can we see cute lions at the zoo today?
character_line.zh: 太棒了！我們今天可以在動物園看到可愛的獅子嗎？

options.en: Yes! We can see lions and monkeys!
options.zh: 可以！我們能看到獅子和猴子！

options.hint: 開心回答「Yes!」告訴 Benny 動物園有獅子和猴子喔！
動物園裡面有好多可愛動物，快跟 Benny 一起去看！

character_line.en: Now we are at the crossroad. How do we go to the bookstore?
character_line.zh: 現在我們來到十字路口了。我們該怎麼去書店呢？

options.en: Turn left, and it is on the right.

options.hint: 指引方向說「Turn left（左轉）」帶 Benny 去書店喔！
告訴 Benny 先向左轉，書店就在右邊喔！

character_line.en: Thank you! What can we find inside the bookstore?
character_line.zh: 謝謝你！我們在書店裡可以找到什麼呢？

options.en: We can find fun picture books there!
options.zh: 我們可以在那裡找到有趣的繪本！

options.en: The cat is climbing the tree.
options.hint: 書店裡有滿滿的精彩童書，告訴 Benny「picture books」喔！
書店是買書和看繪本的地方喔！

character_line.en: Look ahead! Is our school near the big supermarket?
character_line.zh: 看前面！我們的學校在大型超市附近嗎？

options.en: Yes, our school is right next to it!
options.zh: 沒錯，我們的學校就在它的正隔壁！

options.hint: 肯定地回答學校就在超市旁邊「next to it」喔！
看前面那棟漂亮的學校建築就在超市旁喔！

character_line.en: We walked so well and arrived safely! Are you happy?
character_line.zh: 我們走得很好而且平安抵達了！你開心嗎？

options.en: I am super happy! You are a great guide!
options.zh: 我超級開心！你是很棒的嚮導！

options.hint: 謝謝 Benny 帶路，跟他說你有多開心「super happy」吧！
跟熱心的 Benny 擊掌慶祝平安抵達學校吧！
